name: Browser Automation
instructions: Local headless Chrome for this machine. Open a session, then run short scripts (goto, snapshot, click, fill, shot). Not the sidebar Browser tab and not remote hosts. Runs node/npm through bash so GUI PATH still finds Homebrew or nvm. First open installs playwright-core into ~/.kagan/plugins/dev.kagan.browser-automation.

tools.name: browser_open
tools.description: Open a local Chrome session for this thread (headless by default).

tools.name: browser_run
tools.description: Run a trusted browser script in an open session. Use browser.getPage("main").

tools.name: browser_screenshot
tools.description: Capture a JPEG of the main page in a session.

tools.name: browser_list
tools.description: List browser sessions for this thread.

tools.name: browser_stop
tools.description: Stop Chrome for a session without deleting its record.

tools.name: browser_close
tools.description: Close a session and remove its Chrome profile.
